spec:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  d
 - input  ena
 - output q

The module should impement a D latch using an always block.
final_design:
module TopModule (
    input  logic d,
    input  logic ena,
    output logic q
);

    always @(*) begin
        if (ena) begin
            q = d;
        end
    end

endmodule
